title: Ford on track to complete $2B factory overhaul for Fathom EV truck | TechCrunch
summary: To catch up, Ford ditched the moving assembly line system that its founder Henry Ford launched and turned to a system developed by its skunkworks team led by former Tesla executive Alan Clarke.
